minHz.description: Lowest frequency kept, in Hz (default 20, range 20 to below 20000). A higher value removes more of the low band.

maxHz.description: Highest frequency kept, in Hz (default 20000, range above 20 to 20000). A lower value removes more of the high band.

perceptualFloor.description: Zero spectral bins below this fraction of the loudest bin (default 0.003, about -50 dB; range 0.003 to below 1).

perceptualFloorDb.description: The same floor in dB relative to the loudest bin (range -50 to 0). Set this or perceptualFloor, not both.
